literal_meaning: চাটনি (a type of tangy or spicy condiment)
figurative_meaning_en: Sarcastically, an enticing or mouth-watering discussion
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথা শুনে মনে হয় চাটনি খাচ্ছি, কিন্তু কোনো ফলাফল নেই।
সভায় সবাই চাটনির মতো গল্প করছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Listening to him feels like eating chutney—tasty but no real substance.
Everyone in the meeting is just dishing out juicy chit-chat.
note: This idiom uses the appeal of chutney (a popular Bengali side dish) to mock superficially attractive but insubstantial talk.
